rule: A deterministic algorithm may never depend on LLM code or on data an LLM produced. Deterministic output must be reproducible from seeds in git alone, which is impossible if any step reads a cache or aggregate a model wrote.
_quarantined_comment: LLM-owned files. They may talk to a model. Nothing outside this list may import them. Only three remain: the translate client and the grammar brief it sends, kept alive solely because Learn still reads the translation cache they filled. When Learn is rebuilt on the deterministic engine, all three go and this section becomes empty.
_pending_cut_comment: Deterministic code that still reaches LLM code. Each entry is a bug with a known fix, not an accepted dependency. The checker fails on any file NOT in either list, so this set can only shrink.

pending_cut.tools/fonoran-course-phrases-compile.js: Learn phrase roman is compiled from the LLM translation cache at runtime. Fix: compile from the deterministic engine, which removes the cache dependency entirely. Deferred on purpose: Learn is being redesigned as procedural lessons, and rewriting its compiler before that design lands would be work done twice.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-course-phrases-build.js: Inherits from the compiler plus a direct llm-translate import. Same deferral.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-learn-course-phrases.js: Inherits via the course-phrases compiler. Same deferral.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-course-phrases-compile.tes: Inherits via the course-phrases compiler. Same deferral.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-course-phrases.test.js: Inherits via the course-phrases compiler. Same deferral.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-api.js: Serves the Learn course-phrases route, so it inherits the course-phrases compiler. No LLM route remains: the pipeline, candidate, and gap-analyzer routes were deleted.
pending_cut.server.js: Inherits via fonoran-api.js and the Learn route only.
pending_cut.tools/fonoran-data-paths.js: Names the translation cache and the LLM evaluations file. Goes away with the Learn cache dependency.
